column1: # EVENTS-NONE.tsv -- an entry of unicon_uni that waits for an event and is NOT graded on a script of its own work, each with its measured reason (entry, a tab, the reason); the row unicon-graphics-the-waiting-gui-programs-do-their-own-work-half-a and its twin half-b write it

column2: it computes behind its picture: at its still screen the program is runnable 0.94 of the time where a polling gui program is 0.16 (the cqo, still-rule census, /home/resources/progress/unicon-graphics-2026-11-16/still-rule), so it is left on its first picture for the cqo to rule with the still rule, as the row says (officer_12 2026-11-16)

its work is a listing of the machine's root folder, each entry with its size and date, which moves as the box runs (tmp/ and home/ change by the minute; MEASURED: its first picture read md5 9a44452b when the grader cut it and 0c12aeae at 17:0x CST 2026-11-16, twice alike), and the folder is fixed in the program, so no input of ours makes it the same; its stored first picture is stale for the same reason (officer_12 2026-11-16)

its work is a fetch over the network (the goal names it), carried by a child process through package ipc, whose C library uniipclib.so the graphics unicon was built without: MEASURED, a URL typed and Start pressed ends the oracle with run-time error 216, loadfunc of uniipclib.so cannot open file, twice alike (officer_12 2026-11-16)

its work is a leak watch: a ticker every tenth of a second disposes and reopens a child dialog and runs system("free"), printing the box's memory, so its text moves with the box: MEASURED, a Quit after its first picture ended it twice with 5796 and 8901 bytes of free's lines, the numbers different; the stand-in that would fix them is a shim on PATH, which this package's road does not stage (officer_09 2026-11-16)

its work is three Tickers writing lines into an empty 100 by 100 dialog, and it ends only by the window manager's close button, which the road has none of: no event of a script reaches any of it, and the road ends it at its still screen and withholds its text (read in the program, officer_09 2026-11-16)

its work is a tree table of the machine's root folder, each entry with its size, date and mode bits, which moves as the box runs, and the folder is fixed in the program (TreeTableNode label /), as explorer: MEASURED, its first picture read md5 fe38d95a when the grader cut it and 5804ccb1 at 17:29 CST 2026-11-16, so its stored first picture is stale for the same reason (officer_09 2026-11-16)

its work is the Wu programming environment, a window with a Win menu bar over an edit region, but unicon's X11 build raises run-time error 121 `function not supported` at the first Win function, WinMenuBar at its line 214, before any window stands (the Win functions are MS Windows only, skill unicon U5 b): MEASURED on the screen road with no script, twice equal and equal to its stored answer, status 1 and `screen none`, so no event reaches it and it is a big application, which Lon tests by hand with no script (Lon 2026-11-18 13:0x CST, in the president's window, relayed by the cqo) (developer_09 2026-11-18, ruled by the cqo 13:0x CST)

its work is a memory monitor window of another program: given a target program as its argument it runs that program under the event monitor (EvInit) and draws memory bars until a right press or Escape; the entry has no ALL.args line and so no target: MEASURED on the screen road with no script, twice equal and equal to its stored answer, it writes `Memory Monitored Width Hight` and ends by itself status 0, `screen none`, so no event reaches it; a target program built for the event monitor is a monitor-and-trace row of its own, not this one (the cqo's ruling 2026-11-18 13:0x CST; developer_09 2026-11-18)

its work is a TestDialog of the old one-file gui library with a Border that closes when its button is pressed, but its constructor fails before show(): MEASURED on the screen road with no script, twice equal and equal to its stored answer, run-time error 103 `string expected` at gui.icn line 555 (MetaComponent.set_fields given the attribute string "pos0,0", which has no =, so its name is null; from the Border built at i.icn line 12) is the oracle's own answer, status 1, no window, `screen none`, so no event reaches it (developer_09 2026-11-18, ruled by the cqo 13:0x CST)
